timing.availability: For each event use the later of (a) first native Qlib signal date strictly after official filing date and (b) independent original acceptance audit next_Qlib_session. Both must be native calendar dates; never force equality when acceptance is prior evening. AMD 2011-01-21 qualitative event stays unknown.
timing.max_age: Each issuer last numeric event must be no older than four calendar months relative to signal date, using pandas DateOffset(months=4), inclusive. Qualitative event invalidates issuer value until next numeric event.

feature.name: AMD_NVDA_forward_growth_positive_breadth
feature.formula: If both latest issuer source events are numeric and not older than four calendar months, (1[AMD sequential growth>0]+1[NVDA sequential growth>0])/2. Exactly zero is not positive. Otherwise NaN.

stop: Any source hash, event identity, 126 conditional timing audit mismatch, Qlib calendar, missingness or NAS readback failure stops. One D.calendar call, one DatasetH and one new Recorder only; no market outcomes, fits/accounts.
